title: Add a payment method
text: A payment method is one way a customer can pay. What you add here is what the cashier sees at checkout.
steps: Click Sidebar > Payment Methods.
Click Add Payment Method.
Type a name the cashier will recognize, such as GCash or Visa.
Choose the Payment Type.
Turn on Active Status and Available in Cashier.
Click Save. It will appear on the payment screen for the next sale.

title: Which payment type to pick
text: The payment type tells the system how to handle the payment. Choose the option that matches how the customer actually pays.
steps: Normal Payment is cash over the counter.
E-Wallet means GCash, Maya, and similar apps. Debit/Credit Card means a card swipe or tap.
Finance means a loan from Home Credit, Billease, and similar providers. It is not counted as paid at checkout.
Unpaid charges the sale to the customer. Loyalty Points uses points the customer already earned.

title: Let customers pay later on credit
text: If Mark as Paid is turned off, the sale is charged to the customer instead of taking money immediately.
steps: Click Sidebar > Payment Methods.
Click Add Payment Method or edit an existing one.
Turn off Mark as Paid, then click Save.
At checkout, choose the customer and set a due date.
The amount stays under that customer's Receivables until it is paid.

title: Stop using a payment method
text: Turn a payment method off instead of deleting it. Older sales still point to it, so deletion is blocked once it has been used.
steps: Click Sidebar > Payment Methods.
Double-click the method, or click the arrow at the end of the row and choose Edit.
Turn off Active Status, or turn off Available in Cashier to hide it at checkout only.
Click Save.
Delete only works for a method that has never been used on a sale.

title: Require a reference number or add a surcharge
text: E-Wallet and card methods can require a payment reference and add a fee when the customer uses that method.
steps: Click Sidebar > Payment Methods.
Double-click the card or e-wallet method.
Turn on Requires Reference Number so the cashier must enter the GCash or card reference.
Set Payment Charge to a fixed amount or percentage if you want to add a fee.
Add a QR code image if needed, then click Save.

title: Open the cash drawer after a payment
text: Open Cash Drawer makes the drawer open automatically after a sale paid with this method.
steps: Click Sidebar > Payment Methods.
Double-click the payment method.
Turn on Open Cash Drawer, then click Save.
Keep it off for card and e-wallet methods if the drawer should stay closed.

title: Philhealth payments
text: Mark a payment method as Philhealth when the sale is billed to Philhealth. It is not counted as paid at checkout.
steps: Click Sidebar > Payment Methods.
Double-click the payment method.
Turn on This payment method is Philhealth. Mark as Paid turns off automatically.
Click Save.
Sales paid this way appear in the Philhealth report under Reporting.
